title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, bump actions and deps, CI hygiene
author: Priya Patel
description:
Motivation: our GitHub Actions have accumulated multiple overlapping workflows (lint, test, release) and several repositories are still using outdated actions and Node versions. This PR consolidates lint/test/release pipelines into a smaller set of reusable workflows, bumps core actions and Node runtime where safe, and applies general CI hygiene to reduce redundant matrix runs and improve cache hit rates.

What this changes: consolidated workflows under .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml,ci-helpers.yml}; introduced a reusable CI helpers workflow; replaced deprecated actions with maintained equivalents; bumped actions/setup-node to v4, actions/cache improvements, and standardized node-version matrix to [20, 22] where applicable; removed duplicated lint runs across project-level and package-level workflows; reduced parallel test matrix for slow suites and added selective tagging to allow fast PR-only checks.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate lint and test workflows into top-level reusable workflows
- [x] Bump actions/setup-node -> v4 and update cache key schema
- [x] Reduce matrix rows for large integration suites and add canary job for nightly full matrix
- [x] Add explicit node-version pinning for release workflow
- [x] Add notes to README/DEVELOPERS.md about CI changed behavior
- [x] Run CI, fix flakey step in perf canary job

Commits summary: squash of 6 commits - chore: extract reusable workflow templates; chore: replace setup-node v3 -> v4; ci: reduce test matrix for integration suites; fix: restore cache key for pnpm; docs: update DEVELOPERS.md CI section; ci: add nightly full-matrix pipeline.

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/lint.yml (new, uses reusable workflow from ci-helpers)
- .github/workflows/test.yml (new, consolidates unit/integration/test matrices)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (refactor to standardized release steps and node pin)
- .github/workflows/ci-helpers.yml (new, reusable jobs for checkout, setup-node, setup-cache)
- .github/workflows/nightly-full-matrix.yml (new scheduled job for full integration run)
- .github/actions/ (removed vendor action wrappers; replaced direct action refs)
- scripts/ci/cache-key.sh (small helper to generate stable cache keys)
- DEVELOPERS.md (doc update)

Small illustrative snippet (ci-helpers.yml):
name: CI helpers
jobs:
  setup:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-helpers.yml@main
    with:
      node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}

Notes on migration: some packages previously relied on an implicit Node 18 behavior; the standardized node matrix includes 20 and 22 to better reflect our supported runtimes. We added a fast-failing PR-only test set and a nightly full-matrix run to catch regressions. The change to actions/cache increases cache TTL and narrows keys to improve reuse across PRs.

Release notes:
- Consolidated CI workflows for lint/test/release to reduce duplication and improve maintainability
- Bumped core GitHub Actions and standardized node versions (20, 22) for CI
- Introduced nightly full-matrix job for integration test coverage

Risk and follow-ups: occasional flakiness was observed in the perf-canary step; fixed race by adding a small delay and retry logic (script patch included). Platform teams should review Dedicated and Private deploy workflows to ensure there are no infra-specific steps lost in consolidation.

ci: consolidate unit + integration pipelines into test.yml

discussion:
Alex Kim: Please split out the caching changes from the workflow consolidation so we can iterate separately.
Priya (author): I kept them together because the cache key changes are tightly coupled to the reduced matrix to avoid cache pollution; added extra tests to validate.
Jordan Blake: nits on the matrix reduction — prefer explicit OS matrix for a subset of slow jobs. Updated to include explicit os: [ubuntu-latest] for integration-canary.
Marta Alvarez: Approved after small docs tweak.
CI: initial run failed on perf-canary due to timing; rerun after adding retry-with-delay.sh and cache key fix — subsequent run passed.
Maintainers: merged with squash after approvals.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows; bumped actions/setup-node to v4; standardized Node versions (20,22); added nightly full-matrix integration run; CI cache improvements.
notes_for_ops: After merge ops should monitor nightly full-matrix run for first 3 days; watch cache hit-rate metric in CI dashboard and revert if cache churn increases.
